verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs describe the full bill workflow: an invoice is dragged in, matched to its PO, GL-coded, routed for approval and paid. Dynamic approval routing supports parallel workflows across finance, IT, legal and security, and an approval-routing AI agent sits alongside it. The CLI exposes bill draft, pending and approve commands, and the API supports creating bills with attached documents and paying vendors end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the bill-upload-to-approval flow (community evidence covers expense-card approvals, not bills), and detail on how bill approval chains are configured; bill approvals are not yet available via MCP.
